name: gst-plugins-rs
local_changes: Build only gst-plugin-gtk4 with cargo-c (-p gst-plugin-gtk4) instead of the full 59-output workspace split; gthumb needs only gtk4paintablesink.
Restrict cargo features to the gst-plugin-gtk4 crate: dmabuf, gtk_v4_20, v1_28, waylandegl, x11egl, x11glx.
Drop workspace-only build dependencies (csound, dav1d, vulkan, sodium, etc.) not needed by the gtk4 plugin.
Preserve signed source, lockfile patch, checksums and signing key.
